android.desc:
Turn your phone from your biggest distraction into your best study partner. Iterio is a Pomodoro timer and study planner that combines deep-focus work sessions, app blocking, and spaced repetition — so you concentrate fully today and still remember what you learned weeks from now.

Whether you are preparing for entrance exams, studying for professional certifications, learning a language, or simply trying to build a daily study habit, Iterio keeps you focused and on track.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
KEY FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

■ Pomodoro Timer
• Stay focused with classic 25-minute work sessions and 5-minute breaks
• Fully customizable: change work length, break length, and cycle count
• Gentle countdown sound in the last seconds of each session

■ Focus Mode — Block Distracting Apps
• Restrict access to distracting apps while your session is running
• Normal mode: can be unlocked anytime in an emergency
• Strict mode: stronger blocking with an always-available emergency exit
• Allowlist the apps you truly need, like a dictionary or music player

■ Spaced Repetition Review
• Every study record is automatically added to your review schedule
• Reviews at 1, 3, 7, 14, and 30 days, following the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve
• Reminders arrive exactly when a review is most effective for retention
• Stop guessing when to review — let science decide for you

■ Study Tracking
• Log study time by subject and topic
• Attach page ranges and notes to every session
• Templates turn repeat entries into a two-tap job

■ Statistics & Analytics
• Daily, weekly, and monthly study time charts
• Subject distribution shows where your hours really go
• Study streaks keep your motivation high
• Average daily study time at a glance

■ Calendar Heatmap
• GitHub-style contribution graph of your study history
• Spot gaps and patterns in seconds

■ Home Screen Widget
• Check today's study time and streak without opening the app

■ Focus Sounds (Premium)
• Rain, café ambience, white noise, and more
• Generated on your device — no downloads, no streaming, zero data use

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Iterio uses Android's AccessibilityService API only for optional Focus Mode. During a timer, it processes the foreground app package name, screen changes, and window positions and sizes—including Picture-in-Picture—on device to detect blocked apps, return you to Iterio, and show a lock screen. quotes.text:
I built an Android study timer that solves two problems I had while studying for certifications: phone distractions breaking my focus, and forgetting what I studied a week later.

For focus: Three lock modes including "complete lock" that prevents unlocking your phone entirely until the timer ends. It even blocks Picture-in-Picture (that loophole we've all used to escape focus apps).

For retention: Automatic spaced repetition based on the Ebbinghaus curve. Tell it what you studied, and it generates review tasks at optimal intervals (1, 3, 7, 14, 30 days). No manual scheduling.

Also includes subject tracking, stats/heatmaps, encrypted cloud backup, and procedurally generated BGM.

Looking for beta testers—offering free Premium in exchange for feedback on what would make this more useful for your study workflow.

Beta signup: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.iterio.app

Package: com.iterio.app | Android 8.0+ | Contact: iterio.timer.app.help@gmail.com
